KGB wrote: Hi I2F, You have here nice journal.Thanks for you posts. Well you actually post reason for your trade and the same time I try to find it base on my knowledge.Well be honest I will not put there PO and probably even didn't trade as was news time.I put on my chart some Q's which you actually already answer.From your charts I can see I look on my charts differently or better say I am not sure if I will reach any time your level. So here is my reading and only way how I will be enter.

Hi KGB

Sorry for the late reply. So when I looked at your charts I thought that your analysis was excellent. On the other hand I was simply trading the return to the QM level as shown in my chart I had set my PO on the pole down just before it started to flag (the flag shown in your M5 chart). While price was flagging I thought a small QM was forming and I was tempted to trade it but with the news on the way I wondered if price would FO the flag and hit my PO, which it did. In your last chart you marked up where you would enter your trade. I must admit I wasn't analysing PA to that level. But I have seen a few diamonds form during these news periods.

Hope this gives some idea of my thought process which believe me is often flawed,Thanks for your posts. Regards In2forex

posts.t: Hey In2, just a little something that came to mind, and not that it has any relevancy here - but in one trading community I have had some exposure in, a distinctive flip zone is labeled as a "strange attractor". Of course, this particular community is mainly concerned about PA in PRZ's as it relates to harmonic patterns. To them, if a PRZ forms at or near the strange attractor (Flip zone), it is discouraged and considered high risk trade. However, you have proven otherwise.
posts.fa: سلام In2، فقط چیزی به ذهنم رسید و ربطی به اینجا ندارد — ولی در یک جامعهٔ معامله‌گری که کمی با آن آشنا شده‌ام، یک ناحیهٔ فلیپ متمایز با نام "strange attractor" برچسب خورده است. البته آن جامعه عمدتاً به PA در PRZ‌ها در رابطه با پترن‌های هارمونیک اهمیت می‌دهد. برای آن‌ها اگر PRZ روی strange attractor (ناحیهٔ فلیپ) یا نزدیک آن شکل بگیرد، دلسردکننده است و معاملهٔ پرریسکی محسوب می‌شود. با این حال، تو خلاف آن را اثبات کرده‌ای.
